bug_semantics: When Signup and CreateUserDir are enabled, signup derives a per-user home from the username and then asks GetByScope whether that scope is already owned. GetByScope compared Scope with a case-sensitive exact match (storm q.Eq). On a case-insensitive filesystem (confirmed NTFS), CaseVictim and casevictim are distinct database usernames and distinct stored scopes (/users/CaseVictim vs /users/casevictim) but resolve to one physical directory, so the second unauthenticated registrant can read, overwrite, and delete the first account's files through ordinary authenticated HTTP endpoints.
flaw_origin: The first public write of GetByScope using q.Eq("Scope", scope), and of signupHandler calling that check after MakeUserDir, is 883a36f02fcb69566a8628cb47f18fdc73348387 (fix(auth): reject signup when normalized home dir collides, GHSA-7rc3-g7h6-22m7). Immediate parent 8503ba61ff51d48a7313896483d130eb6a5abfe0 has storage/bolt/users.go, users/storage.go, and http/auth.go, but GetByScope and the signup scope-ownership check are absent. That commit closed lossy cleanUsername collisions with a case-sensitive string compare and left case-folded aliases uncaught.
ai_marker: Absent on BIC 883a36f02fcb69566a8628cb47f18fdc73348387. git cat-file -p shows author and committer Henrique Dias <mail@hacdias.com>, a single parent, an SSH signature, subject fix(auth): reject signup when normalized home dir collides (GHSA-7rc3-g7h6-22m7), and no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, Made-with, or bot-author marker.
evidence: First-party advisory https://github.com/filebrowser/filebrowser/security/advisories/GHSA-576v-w77m-gr84 (CVE-2026-72836 / GHSA-f37p-wpgx-m9mr) states that the v2.63.17 GHSA-7rc3 GetByScope ownership check compares persisted scope as an exact case-sensitive string, so CaseVictim and casevictim share one NTFS home. Affected: <=2.63.18. Patched: 2.63.19. withdrawn_at is null.

git log -S 'q.Eq("Scope"' -- storage/bolt/users.go first hits 883a36f02fcb69566a8628cb47f18fdc73348387, which adds usersBackend.GetByScope as st.db.Select(q.Eq("Scope", scope)).First(user) and wires signupHandler to return 409 when CreateUserDir is on and that lookup succeeds. git grep GetByScope on parent 8503ba61ff51d48a7313896483d130eb6a5abfe0 -- storage/bolt/users.go users/storage.go http/auth.go is empty. git cat-file -e 8503ba61:storage/bolt/users.go succeeds, so the parent tree exists and simply lacks the vulnerable function.

git cat-file -p 883a36f02fcb69566a8628cb47f18fdc73348387: single parent 8503ba61ff51d48a7313896483d130eb6a5abfe0, author and committer Henrique Dias <mail@hacdias.com>, 2026-06-27, SSH-signed. No AI trailer. The commit is a direct non-merge object, not a GitHub squash aggregate.

At that BIC, settings/dir.go cleanUsername still allows A-Za-z and preserves case (invalidFilenameChars = [^0-9A-Za-z@_\-.]). users.User.Username is storm:"unique" with case-sensitive equality, so CaseVictim and casevictim both persist. MakeUserDir builds path.Join(UserHomeBasePath, username) then path.Join("/", userScope).

The GitHub Advisory Database reference commit fe7efb2e6afe66774cd86a5b0a03033bd514d0c0 is chore(release): 2.63.18 and only edits CHANGELOG.md; it does not close the sink. The actual closer is 4b8a8d72ce554dde378b5091da74aa930ea18327 (fix(storage): reject case-folded home directory collisions, Refs GHSA-576v-w77m-gr84), which replaces q.Eq with pattern := "(?i)^" + regexp.QuoteMeta(scope) + "$" and q.Re("Scope", pattern) in storage/bolt/users.go only.

Author and committer Henrique Dias <mail@hacdias.com>, no AI trailer. git merge-base --is-ancestor shows 4b8a8d72 is in tag v2.63.19 (712ad22d32aaae61e24abe03bda1b81bb65c538c) and not in v2.63.18 (8e86e64846c5a1ea65357deac7ffdefc3f4a2fd3). CHANGELOG 2.63.19 lists that storage fix.

8ddd3d1db9b9f5727d0bf96ea0e7d9a25a8692b4 and fb6aeba9eae7b8eb401e0db325973781e1ffd08b reuse GetByScope for proxy/hook provisioning and make the check atomic with save; they do not change the Eq comparison. 7453c78c9877cbee71dfbad06326d450102e59de is a later test-only cover of the case-insensitive match.
reasoning: This is a real CWE-178 residual after the GHSA-7rc3 collision check: the first-write of that check used a case-sensitive Eq, so case-folded homes on NTFS still aliased. The smallest commit that first wrote those GetByScope/q.Eq lines, and the signup call that depends on them, is 883a36f02fcb69566a8628cb47f18fdc73348387; the parent tree has the surrounding files but not the function or the check. AI is judged only on that BIC object: human Henrique Dias, no AI trailer. The later case-insensitive Re patch 4b8a8d72ce554dde378b5091da74aa930ea18327 is the direct closer and lands in 2.63.19; the 2.63.18 release SHA named in the GitHub advisory database is not a fix. CreateUserDir/cleanUsername predates this CVE but is not the code the patch changed, and treating a prior incomplete-remediation as the BIC for this advisory would invert the search away from the lines that first implemented the failing ownership check.
